parsed.summary: The proposed patch changes the behavior of the `__subclasscheck__` method in `AutoFieldMeta` to use `issubclass` instead of direct membership check. This change is intended to fix the issue with subclasses of `BigAutoField` and `SmallAutoField` not being recognized as valid primary keys.

issues.description: The patch uses `issubclass` with `self._subclasses`, which is a tuple of classes. This will always return `False` because `issubclass` expects a class as the second argument, not a tuple of classes. This change will not fix the intended issue and may introduce unexpected behavior.
